q.zh: Sleepy 和 WakeUp 课程表是什么关系？
q.en: What is the relationship between Sleepy and WakeUp Course Schedule?

inline.v: 没有隶属关系。Sleepy 是独立的开源 Android 项目，有自己的代码库和维护者。两者只在数据格式层面兼容：Sleepy 可以导入 WakeUp 导出的 JSON / 分享文本，也可以导出 WakeUp 兼容 JSON。

None. Sleepy is an independent open-source Android project with its own repository and maintainer. The two are compatible at the data-format level only: Sleepy can import JSON and share-text exported by WakeUp, and can export WakeUp-compatible JSON.

q.zh: Sleepy 免费吗？有广告或内购吗？
q.en: Is Sleepy free? Does it have ads or in-app purchases?

inline.v: 免费，许可证是 GPL-3.0。没有广告、订阅、内购或付费等级。公开 APK 从
GitHub Releases
下载。
It is free under the GPL-3.0 license. There are no ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or paid tiers. The public APK is downloaded from
GitHub Releases

q.zh: 需要注册账号吗？
q.en: Do I need to register an account?

inline.v: 不需要账号、邮箱、手机号或学号。打开应用后可以直接手动建表，或导入已有课表。
No account, email, phone number or student ID is required. After opening the app you can build a schedule manually or import an existing one.

q.zh: 会收集或上传数据吗？
q.en: Does it collect or upload data?

inline.v: 课表和设置存储在本机。项目不集成 Firebase Analytics、Crashlytics、Sentry、Bugsnag、AppCenter、Bugly 等分析或崩溃上报 SDK，也不要求登录云端账号。教务导入会访问学校站点，节假日刷新会下载公共日期数据，版本检查和下载会访问 GitHub 或项目镜像；普通查看和编辑课表可离线完成。关于页提供隐私政策入口链接。

Schedules and settings are stored on the device. The project integrates no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs such as Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugsnag, AppCenter or Bugly, and does not require a cloud login. Academic-affairs import visits the school site, holiday refresh downloads public date data, and version checks and downloads access GitHub or the project mirror; viewing and editing schedules work offline. The About page links the hosted privacy policy.

q.zh: 谁维护？在哪里反馈问题？
q.en: Who maintains it? Where do I report problems?

inline.v: 项目由 Lingion 维护。Bug、新学校适配和功能建议请发到
GitHub Issues
；讨论可发到
Discussions
。提交教务问题时不要附账号、密码、验证码、Cookie、token 或个人课表。
The project is maintained by Lingion. Bugs, new-school adaptations and feature requests go to
GitHub Issues
; discussion goes to
Discussions
. When reporting academic-affairs problems, never attach accounts, passwords, verification codes, cookies, tokens or personal schedules.

q.zh: 如何支持这个项目？
q.en: How can I support the project?

inline.v: 项目接受自愿赞助，支付宝 / 微信收款码见
赞助页
。赞助不影响任何功能，Sleepy 始终免费且无付费等级。
The project accepts voluntary sponsorship; Alipay and WeChat QR codes are on the
sponsor page
. Sponsoring never unlocks features: Sleepy stays free with no paid tiers.

q.zh: 支持什么 Android 版本？
q.en: Which Android version is supported?

inline.v: 最低 Android 8.0（API 26），target / compile SDK 为 37。正式应用包名为
com.lingion.sleepy
，调试构建为
com.lingion.sleepy.debug
，二者数据隔离。
Minimum Android 8.0 (API 26); target / compile SDK is 37. The release application id is
com.lingion.sleepy
, debug builds use
com.lingion.sleepy.debug
; their data is isolated.

q.zh: 当前版本是多少？
q.en: What is the current version?

inline.v: 构建版本从 Git 标签派生；无可用标签时回退到发布说明。已安装版本见应用「关于」，公开发布版本以
GitHub Releases
页面为准。
The build version derives from Git tags; with no usable tag it falls back to release notes. Your installed version is shown under "About" in the app; public releases are authoritative on the
GitHub Releases
page.

q.zh: 提供哪些 APK ABI？
q.en: Which APK ABIs are provided?

inline.v: 发布构建分别提供：

items.v: ：包含所有上述 ABI；不确定架构时可选

inline.v: Release builds provide separately:

items.v: : contains all ABIs above; pick it when the architecture is unknown

q.zh: 有 iOS、Windows 或网页版本吗？
q.en: Are there iOS, Windows or web versions?

inline.v: 本仓库原生应用面向 Android。iOS 版在独立仓库
lingion/sleepy-ios
维护：SwiftUI + WidgetKit 原生实现，iOS 16.0 起，与 Android 版功能对齐，IPA 从该仓库
Releases
下载（当前为未签名构建，安装前需自行重签）。另有
官网
与
在线体验
；在线体验不代表网页与原生应用的功能完全相同。Windows 版暂无。
The native app in this repository targets Android. An iOS port is maintained in the separate repository
lingion/sleepy-ios
: native SwiftUI + WidgetKit, iOS 16.0 and up, feature-aligned with the Android releases; IPA downloads come from that repository's
Releases
(currently unsigned builds that need to be re-signed before installation). There is also an
official website
and an
online trial
; the online trial does not imply the web and native feature sets are identical. No Windows version.

q.zh: 我的学校不在名单里怎么办？
q.en: What if my school is not on the list?

inline.v: 学校选择页是全国学校目录，逐校标注导入状态：一部分学校已带教务协议、可直接路由导入；其余为目录登记、解析器尚未接入，应用内明示——「还没适配」和「没有这所学校」是两回事。目录中没有你的学校，或学校显示未适配而你想推动适配时：先在学校选择页搜索全名/别名，或输入教务 URL 尝试识别；仍失败时，在
Issues
使用学校适配模板，提供学校教务系统地址、失败页面和操作步骤。不要提交任何登录凭据或未脱敏的个人数据。

The school-picking page is a national school catalog with an explicit import status per school: a subset carries a routing protocol and imports directly, the rest are catalog registrations whose parsers are not wired yet and are marked as such in-app — "not adapted yet" and "no such school" are now different things. If your school is missing from the catalog, or shows as not adapted and you want to push adaptation forward: first search the full name or alias on the school-picking page, or enter the academic-affairs URL to try identification. If that still fails, open an
Issue
with the school adaptation template, providing the school's academic-affairs address, failing page and steps. Never submit login credentials or unredacted personal data.

q.zh: 从目录里未验证的学校导入成功了，维护者怎么知道？
q.en: I imported successfully from a catalog school that isn't verified — does the maintainer know?

inline.v: 从未在线验证过的学校导入成功后会弹出成功报告，一键复制：版本、日期、校名、目录 ID、协议、课程数。不发任何网络请求、不自动上传；报告只含学校侧公开信息，粘贴到 Issues 或 Discussions 即可帮助维护者确认协议可用。

Importing from a catalog entry that has not been verified online pops a success report you can copy in one tap: app version, date, school name, catalog ID, protocol, course count. Nothing is uploaded and no network request is made; the report contains only school-side public facts. Paste it into an Issue or Discussion to confirm the protocol works.

q.zh: 教务导入如何工作？账号密码会被保存吗？
q.en: How does the academic-affairs import work? Are my credentials stored?

inline.v: 应用在设备上的 WebView 中打开学校教务登录页，由用户自己输入凭据，再解析返回的课表页面或接口数据。Sleepy 不把教务账号密码写入课表数据库。导入失败时，排查材料也必须按项目适配指南脱敏。

The app opens the school's login page in an on-device WebView, the user enters credentials there, and returned schedule pages or API data are parsed. Sleepy does not write academic-affairs credentials into the schedule database. Failure-triage material must also be redacted per the project's adaptation guide.

q.zh: 支持哪些导入格式？
q.en: Which import formats are supported?

inline.v: 当前解析器支持：
解析器会按内容识别格式，不需要用户先选一个内部协议名称。旧的 WakeUp 数据格式继续保留兼容。
The current parser supports:
The parser detects the format from content; users never pick an internal protocol name first. Legacy WakeUp data formats remain compatible.

q.zh: `sleepy-v1` 是什么？
q.en: What is `sleepy-v1`?

inline.v: Sleepy 的原生纯文本交换格式，包含
chk
完整性字段，用于在导入导出时校验内容。它不是对旧 WakeUp 格式的替代要求；已有 WakeUp JSON、分享文本和 ICS 仍可继续导入。
Sleepy's native plain-text exchange format, carrying a
chk
integrity field used to verify content on import and export. It is not a replacement requirement for the old WakeUp format: existing WakeUp JSON, share text and ICS still import.

q.zh: 可以导出什么？
q.en: What can I export?

inline.v: 课表可以导出为 WakeUp 兼容 JSON、ICS 和
sleepy-v1
；两个分享入口（导出页分享文本、顶栏分享面板）输出的就是
sleepy-v1
原生格式，分享出去的课表当纯文本也能读，导入回环不变。Android 10+ 将 JSON/ICS 写入
Download/Sleepy/
；Android 8–9 使用应用缓存并经 FileProvider 分享，分享文本与 sleepy-v1 使用系统分享面板。作息表可导出 JSON 或 sleepy-v1。ICS 可交给系统日历、Google Calendar 或其他支持 iCalendar 的应用。
Schedules export as WakeUp-compatible JSON, ICS and
sleepy-v1
; both share entry points (export-page share text and the top-bar share sheet) emit
sleepy-v1
natively, so a shared timetable reads as plain text and the import round-trip is unchanged. On Android 10+ JSON/ICS are written to
Download/Sleepy/

; on Android 8–9 the app cache plus FileProvider sharing is used, and share text and sleepy-v1 go through the system share sheet. Timetables export as JSON or sleepy-v1. ICS files can be handed to the system calendar, Google Calendar or any iCalendar app.

q.zh: 可以导出到小爱课程表吗？
q.en: Can I export to the Xiaoai class table?

inline.v: 可以。导出页提供「导出到小爱课程表」：课表在本地生成并校验周次范围、日期与作息表字段后，经深链交给小爱（小米语音助手）课程表导入器。最终导入体验以小爱客户端的接收为准。

Yes. The export page offers "Export to Xiaoai class table": the timetable is generated and validated locally — week range, dates and time-schedule fields — then handed to the Xiaoai (Xiaomi assistant) class-table importer via deep link. The final import experience depends on the Xiaoai client receiving it.

q.zh: 可以直接写入系统日历吗？
q.en: Can it write to the system calendar directly?

inline.v: 可以。在导出页选设备上的可写日历、日期范围，预览后确认；此操作才申请日历读写权限。可应用调课和日历提醒。设备没有 Google 账号或任何日历账号、可写日历列表为空时，Sleepy 会按需创建一个自有隐藏本地日历；增量指纹写入保证重复导出不覆盖你在日历应用里的手动编辑。实验性第 1 节闹钟取决于日历应用和账户支持。

Yes. On the export page pick a writable calendar on the device and a date range, preview, then confirm; calendar read/write permission is requested only at this step. Rescheduled classes and calendar reminders apply. When the device has no Google account or any calendar account and the writable-calendar list is empty, Sleepy creates its own hidden local calendar on demand; incremental fingerprint upsert means re-exporting never wipes your manual edits in the calendar app. The experimental first-period alarm depends on calendar app and account support.

q.zh: 如何完整备份或换机？
q.en: How do I back up everything or move to a new device?

inline.v: 「通用设置 → 数据迁移」导出
.sleepybackup
，包含课表、作息表、偏好和小组件配置。恢复可选合并或覆盖；合并保留本机课表并追加，但同名偏好键采用备份值；覆盖只替换备份包含的课表与设置模块，包内缺失的偏好文件保留本机值。单张课表 JSON/ICS 不等于全量备份。
"General settings → Data migration" exports a
.sleepybackup

containing schedules, timetables, preferences and widget configuration. Restore offers merge or overwrite: merge keeps local schedules and appends, but same-name preference keys take the backup's values; overwrite replaces only the schedule and settings modules present in the package, keeping local values for preference files absent from it. A single schedule's JSON/ICS is not a full backup.

q.zh: 需要哪些权限？
q.en: Which permissions are required?

inline.v: 学校选择的定位按钮按需请求前台位置；提醒开启时请求通知，相关页面提供精确闹钟、电池优化、勿扰访问入口；写入系统日历请求日历读写；应用内更新安装需未知来源安装权限。普通离线查看课表不要求授予这些可选权限。

The school-picker location button requests foreground location on demand; enabling reminders requests notification permission, with pages offering exact-alarm, battery-optimization and do-not-disturb access entries; writing the system calendar requests calendar read/write; in-app update installation requires unknown-source install permission. Ordinary offline schedule viewing asks for none of these optional permissions.

q.zh: 能同时保存多张课表吗？
q.en: Can I keep multiple schedules at once?

inline.v: 可以。多张课表独立保存，每张表可以有自己的开学日期、最大周数和节次时间表。
Yes. Each schedule is stored independently, with its own semester start date, maximum week count and period timetable.

q.zh: 同一时间有两门课会丢课吗？
q.en: If two courses overlap in time, is one lost?

inline.v: 不会因为界面只显示一层就删除数据。冲突布局保留重叠课程，点击被遮挡区域可以查看其他课程；手动添加冲突课程时会展示星期、节次、周次和冲突课程信息。

No data is deleted just because the interface shows one layer. The conflict layout keeps overlapping courses; tapping a covered area shows the others; manually adding a conflicting course displays weekday, period, weeks and the conflicting course details.

q.zh: 撤回能撤回什么？
q.en: What can undo revert?

inline.v: 撤回最近一次课表数据修改，重做可恢复刚撤回的操作。切换当前课表不是数据修改，不会被当作一条课程编辑记录。
The most recent schedule-data change; redo restores what was just undone. Switching the current schedule is not a data change and never counts as a course-edit record.

q.zh: 节次时间可以自动计算吗？
q.en: Can period times be calculated automatically?

inline.v: 可以。作息表支持手动逐节填写，也支持根据首节时间、每节时长、节数和课间模板推算时间。不同课表可以绑定不同作息表。导入教务课表时恒会创建对应作息表。

Yes. Timetables support per-period manual entry and derivation from the first period's start, per-class duration, period count and inter-class break template. Different schedules can bind different timetables. Importing an academic-affairs timetable always creates its time-schedule alongside it.

q.zh: 周视图能显示日期吗？
q.en: Does the week view show dates?

inline.v: 可以。开启「显示星期」后，周视图课程旁与日详情栏会打印真实日期（M 月 d 日），不用从教学周倒推。
Yes. With "show weekday" enabled, the week view prints the actual date (M/d) next to each course and in the day detail panel — no more counting back from the class week.

q.zh: 长课间怎么显示？
q.en: How are long breaks rendered?

inline.v: 课与课之间的长空档渲染为悬浮薄带而不是拉高的空行：行高保持刚性，紧邻薄带的课程卡满高显示，用餐时段按时间比例标识。表头可隐藏时间行。

A long gap between classes renders as a thin floating band instead of a stretched empty row: row heights stay rigid, course cards next to a band keep full height, meal breaks are marked proportionally to time, and the header can hide the time row.

q.zh: 有哪些小组件？
q.en: Which widgets exist?

inline.v: 当前有五个 widget 家族：
它们按桌面尺寸提供固定尺寸变体，当前资源中有 13 个 widget 配置 XML。渲染使用同步
RemoteViews + Canvas
。管理入口在独立的「添加或管理桌面小组件」页：全部变体进添加画廊，启动器预览按真实渲染器等比重绘，刷新按钮就在组件旁边。
There are five widget families now:

items.v: : today and tomorrow in two columns

inline.v: They ship fixed-size variants per launcher; resources currently hold 13 widget configuration XMLs. Rendering uses synchronous
RemoteViews + Canvas

. Management lives on its own "Add or Manage Widgets" page: all variants in an add gallery, launcher previews re-rendered at true scale from the real widget faces, and the refresh button next to the widgets it refreshes.

q.zh: 为什么 OPPO / 一加 / ColorOS 桌面上的 widget 可能空白？
q.en: Why might widgets be blank on OPPO / OnePlus / ColorOS launchers?

inline.v: 旧版本使用 Glance 异步 SessionWorker 时，部分 ColorOS 桌面会冻结该工作线程。v1.0.29 起主渲染路径改为同步 RemoteViews + Canvas。若仍不刷新，检查桌面权限、省电限制和通知权限，并先手动刷新 widget。

Older versions used Glance's asynchronous SessionWorker, which some ColorOS launchers froze. Since v1.0.29 the main render path is synchronous RemoteViews + Canvas. If a widget still misses refreshes, check launcher permissions, battery limits and notification permission, and refresh the widget manually first.

q.zh: Widget 颜色和应用不一致怎么办？
q.en: Widget colors differ from the app; what do I do?

inline.v: 主题颜色来自应用的主题设置；课程颜色跟随外观中「课程配色」所选档位。刷新应用主题后，应用会广播 widget 更新；如果桌面仍显示旧内容，移除并重新添加 widget，或检查系统对后台和桌面组件的限制。

Theme colors come from the app's theme settings; course colors follow the mode selected under Appearance → Course colors. After the app theme changes, the app broadcasts widget updates; if the launcher still shows old content, remove and re-add the widget, or check system limits on background and launcher components.

q.zh: 可以提前多少分钟提醒？
q.en: How many minutes ahead can it remind?

inline.v: 课前提醒支持输入 1 到 999 分钟，不限于几个固定选项。今日摘要、明日摘要和课前提醒的总开关在「我的 → 提醒」中分别设置，每张课表另有独立开关。

Pre-class reminders accept 1 to 999 minutes, not just a few fixed options. Today summary, tomorrow summary and pre-class reminders are configured separately under "Mine → Reminders", and each schedule has its own switch.

q.zh: 课前提醒的横幅和流体云是什么关系？
q.en: What is the relationship between the banner and Fluid Cloud reminder?

inline.v: 二选一：横幅是普通可划通知，手环等设备天然兼容；流体云是实况卡片，属实验能力，显示效果受系统和厂商支持影响。两者互斥，切回横幅会真正停止流体云投放服务。旧的双开关配置无损迁移。

It is an either/or choice: banner is a plain dismissable notification and is naturally wearable-friendly; Fluid Cloud is a promoted live card, experimental, with display depending on system and vendor support. The two are mutually exclusive, and switching back to banner truly stops the cast service. The old pair of switches migrates losslessly.

q.zh: 多张课表的提醒会刷屏吗？
q.en: Will multiple schedules spam me with reminders?

inline.v: 课表名]」前缀。点按进入统一每日议程，也支持给定日期直达。
timetable]` prefix. Tapping it opens the unified daily agenda, which also accepts a date and jumps straight there.

q.zh: 每张课表的提醒开关在哪里？
q.en: Where are the per-timetable reminder switches?

inline.v: 「我的 → 提醒 → 课表提醒」独立页面：全部课表与各自开关一屏排开，总开关关着也能先配置。
On their own page: Mine → Reminders → Table reminders. All tables and their switches in one list; you can preconfigure while the master switch is off.

q.zh: 节假日、调休和上课勿扰怎么设置？
q.en: How do I set holidays, swapped rest days and class do-not-disturb?

inline.v: 节假日与调课映射在通用设置中管理，各课表单独保存调课。提醒页独立配置日期规则，并可在授予系统勿扰访问后启用上课自动勿扰、下课恢复。流体云属于实验能力，显示效果受系统和厂商支持影响。

Holidays and reschedule mappings are managed in general settings; each schedule stores its own reschedules. The reminders page configures date rules independently, and class-time auto do-not-disturb with resume-on-end can be enabled after granting system DND access. Fluid Cloud is experimental; its display depends on system and vendor support.

q.zh: 提醒是云推送吗？
q.en: Are reminders cloud push?

inline.v: 不是。提醒在设备本地调度，使用 AlarmManager，并在 Android 版本允许的范围内提供精确与非精确路径；设备重启或应用更新后由 BootReceiver 恢复调度。
No. Reminders are scheduled on the device with AlarmManager, offering exact and inexact paths within what the Android version allows; after reboot or app update BootReceiver restores the schedule.

q.zh: 关闭提醒后还会收到吗？
q.en: Will I still get reminders after turning them off?

inline.v: 应用的提醒总开关关闭后不会主动安排新的提醒；单张课表的提醒开关也可以单独关闭。Android 系统通知权限仍由系统设置控制；若通知被系统或厂商省电策略拦截，需要在系统设置里恢复权限。

With the app's master reminder switch off, no new reminders are scheduled; each timetable's own switch can also be turned off individually. Android notification permission remains controlled by system settings; if notifications are intercepted by the system or vendor battery policy, restore the permission in system settings.

q.zh: 支持深色模式和系统动态色吗？
q.en: Are dark mode and system dynamic color supported?

inline.v: 「我的 → 外观与主题」支持跟随系统、浅色和深色模式。Android 12 及以上可以使用 Material You 壁纸动态色；不支持动态色的设备使用预设主题色。
"Mine → Appearance & theme" supports following the system, light and dark modes. Android 12+ can use Material You wallpaper-based dynamic color; devices without dynamic color use preset theme colors.

q.zh: 能自定义主题颜色吗？
q.en: Can I customize theme colors?

inline.v: 可以创建和编辑自定义主题，设置主色、次色、第三强调色以及表面色调。编辑当前正在使用的自定义主题并保存后，颜色会立即重新应用，不需要先点击其他主题卡片再点回来。

Yes. Custom themes can be created and edited: primary, secondary, tertiary accent and surface tint. Editing and saving the custom theme in use re-applies colors immediately — no need to tap another theme card first and tap back.

q.zh: 课程颜色是怎么决定的？能跟随主题吗？
q.en: How are course colors decided? Can they follow the theme?

inline.v: 「外观 → 课程配色」三档：经典撒色是旧的稳定黄金角 HSL 分布，行为不变；跟随主题把课程色相放在当前主题色的安全弧上，避开主题色带与补色带；自定义可拖动一次种子色，全表课程围绕它重新编排。色相按课程组 ID 落库，改名或重新导入课表不会再换颜色。控件统一为轨道式分段开关。

Appearance → Course colors has three modes: Classic keeps the old stable golden-angle HSL scatter unchanged; Follow Theme places course hues on a safe arc of the current theme color, carving out the theme band and the complement band; Custom lets you drag a seed hue once and every course re-harmonizes around it. Hues persist per course group ID, so renaming a course or re-importing a timetable no longer reshuffles colors. The switches are rail-style segmented controls throughout.

q.zh: 选中主题卡片会改变卡片尺寸吗？
q.en: Does selecting a theme card change the card's size?

inline.v: 选中指示器使用固定尺寸槽位，选中和未选中状态应保持相同卡片布局尺寸；选中态通过颜色层级和对勾表达。
The selection indicator uses a fixed-size slot; selected and unselected states keep the same card layout size, with the selected state expressed through color hierarchy and a check mark.

q.zh: 如何编译？
q.en: How do I build?

inline.v: 需要 JDK 17。Linux / macOS：

zh.text:
git clone https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.git
cd sleepy
./gradlew assembleDebug

inline.v: Windows 使用
gradlew.bat assembleDebug
。Debug APK 位于
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
，ABI 拆分构建会生成对应 ABI 文件。
JDK 17 is required. Linux / macOS:

en.text:
git clone https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.git
cd sleepy
./gradlew assembleDebug

inline.v: On Windows use
gradlew.bat assembleDebug
. The debug APK lands in
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
; ABI-split builds generate one file per ABI.

q.zh: 如何跑测试？
q.en: How do I run tests?

inline.v: 测试源码位于
app/src/test/
，覆盖解析器、课表数据、冲突布局、周次计算、widget 逻辑、主题契约和导入导出等模块。不要把本机真实账号、教务会话或个人课表放入 fixture。
Test sources are under
app/src/test/

, covering parsers, schedule data, conflict layout, week calculation, widget logic, theme contracts and import/export modules. Never put real local accounts, academic-affairs sessions or personal schedules into fixtures.

q.zh: 如何贡献？
q.en: How do I contribute?

inline.v: 先读
CONTRIBUTING.md
和对应的项目 SOP，再提交一个边界清楚的变更。新学校适配必须补协议证据、脱敏 fixture 和测试。提交作者邮箱使用项目约定的
lingion@hrbeu.edu.cn
，commit 不添加 Claude 的署名尾注。
Read
CONTRIBUTING.md
and the matching project SOP first, then submit one well-scoped change. New school adaptations must add protocol evidence, redacted fixtures and tests. Use the project-convention author email
lingion@hrbeu.edu.cn
, and commits carry no Claude attribution trailer.
